37: // InternalIssuer is a certificate issuer that generates
38: // certificates internally using a locally-configured
39: // CA which can be customized using the `pki` app.
40: type InternalIssuer struct {
41: 	// The ID of the CA to use for signing. The default
42: 	// CA ID is "local". The CA can be configured with the
43: 	// `pki` app.
44: 	CA string `json:"ca,omitempty"`
45: 
46: 	// The validity period of certificates.
47: 	Lifetime caddy.Duration `json:"lifetime,omitempty"`
48: 
49: 	// If true, the root will be the issuer instead of
50: 	// the intermediate. This is NOT recommended and should
51: 	// only be used when devices/clients do not properly
52: 	// validate certificate chains.
53: 	SignWithRoot bool `json:"sign_with_root,omitempty"`
54: 
55: 	ca     *caddypki.CA
56: 	logger *zap.Logger
57: }

59: // CaddyModule returns the Caddy module information.
60: func (InternalIssuer) CaddyModule() caddy.ModuleInfo {

62: 		ID:  "tls.issuance.internal",
63: 		New: func() caddy.Module { return new(InternalIssuer) },
64: 	}

67: // Provision sets up the issuer.
68: func (iss *InternalIssuer) Provision(ctx caddy.Context) error {
69: 	iss.logger = ctx.Logger()
70: 
71: 	// set some defaults
72: 	if iss.CA == "" {
73: 		iss.CA = caddypki.DefaultCAID
74: 	}
75: 
76: 	// get a reference to the configured CA
77: 	appModule, err := ctx.App("pki")
78: 	if err != nil {
79: 		return err
80: 	}
81: 	pkiApp := appModule.(*caddypki.PKI)
82: 	ca, err := pkiApp.GetCA(ctx, iss.CA)
83: 	if err != nil {
84: 		return err
85: 	}
86: 	iss.ca = ca
87: 
88: 	// set any other default values
89: 	if iss.Lifetime == 0 {
90: 		iss.Lifetime = caddy.Duration(defaultInternalCertLifetime)
91: 	}
92: 
93: 	return nil
94: }

97: // configured CA endpoint.

102: // Issue issues a certificate to satisfy the CSR.
103: func (iss InternalIssuer) Issue(ctx context.Context, csr *x509.CertificateRequest) (*certmagic.IssuedCertificate, error) {
104: 	// prepare the signing authority
105: 	authCfg := caddypki.AuthorityConfig{
106: 		SignWithRoot: iss.SignWithRoot,
107: 	}
108: 	auth, err := iss.ca.NewAuthority(authCfg)
109: 	if err != nil {

111: 	}

114: 	var issuerCert *x509.Certificate
115: 	if iss.SignWithRoot {
116: 		issuerCert = iss.ca.RootCertificate()
117: 	} else {
118: 		issuerCert = iss.ca.IntermediateCertificate()
119: 	}
120: 
121: 	// ensure issued certificate does not expire later than its issuer
122: 	lifetime := time.Duration(iss.Lifetime)
123: 	if time.Now().Add(lifetime).After(issuerCert.NotAfter) {
124: 		lifetime = time.Until(issuerCert.NotAfter)
125: 		iss.logger.Warn("cert lifetime would exceed issuer NotAfter, clamping lifetime",

127: 			zap.Duration("lifetime", lifetime),
128: 			zap.Time("not_after", issuerCert.NotAfter),
129: 		)
130: 	}

132: 	certChain, err := auth.SignWithContext(ctx, csr, provisioner.SignOptions{}, customCertLifetime(caddy.Duration(lifetime)))
133: 	if err != nil {
134: 		return nil, err
135: 	}
136: 
137: 	var buf bytes.Buffer
138: 	for _, cert := range certChain {
139: 		err := pem.Encode(&buf, &pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: cert.Raw})
140: 		if err != nil {
141: 			return nil, err
142: 		}
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	return &certmagic.IssuedCertificate{
146: 		Certificate: buf.Bytes(),
147: 	}, nil
148: }

152: //	... internal {
153: //	    ca       <name>
154: //	    lifetime <duration>
155: //	    sign_with_root

157: func (iss *InternalIssuer) UnmarshalCaddyfile(d *caddyfile.Dispenser) error {
158: 	d.Next() // consume issuer name
159: 	for d.NextBlock(0) {
160: 		switch d.Val() {
161: 		case "ca":

168: 				return d.ArgErr()
169: 			}
170: 			dur, err := caddy.ParseDuration(d.Val())
171: 			if err != nil {
172: 				return err
173: 			}
174: 			iss.Lifetime = caddy.Duration(dur)
175: 
176: 		case "sign_with_root":
177: 			if d.NextArg() {
178: 				return d.ArgErr()
179: 			}
180: 			iss.SignWithRoot = true
181: 		}

183: 	return nil
184: }

186: // customCertLifetime allows us to customize certificates that are issued
187: // by Smallstep libs, particularly the NotBefore & NotAfter dates.
188: type customCertLifetime time.Duration

190: func (d customCertLifetime) Modify(cert *x509.Certificate, _ provisioner.SignOptions) error {
191: 	cert.NotBefore = time.Now()
192: 	cert.NotAfter = cert.NotBefore.Add(time.Duration(d))

26: func init() {
27: 	httpcaddyfile.RegisterDirective("acme_server", parseACMEServer)
28: }

30: // parseACMEServer sets up an ACME server handler from Caddyfile tokens.
31: //
32: //	acme_server [<matcher>] {
33: //		ca        <id>
34: //		lifetime  <duration>
35: //		resolvers <addresses...>
36: //		challenges <challenges...>
37: //		allow_wildcard_names
38: //		allow {
39: //			domains <domains...>
40: //			ip_ranges <addresses...>
41: //		}
42: //		deny {
43: //			domains <domains...>
44: //			ip_ranges <addresses...>
45: //		}
46: //	}
47: func parseACMEServer(h httpcaddyfile.Helper) ([]httpcaddyfile.ConfigValue, error) {
48: 	h.Next() // consume directive name
49: 	matcherSet, hasMatcher, err := h.MatcherToken()
50: 	if err != nil {
51: 		return nil, err
52: 	}
53: 	if hasMatcher {
54: 		h.Dispenser.Delete()
55: 	}
56: 	h.Dispenser.Reset()
57: 	h.Next() // consume the directive name again (matcher parsing resets)
58: 
59: 	// no inline args allowed
60: 	if h.NextArg() {
61: 		return nil, h.ArgErr()
62: 	}
63: 
64: 	var acmeServer Handler
65: 	var ca *caddypki.CA
66: 
67: 	for h.NextBlock(0) {
68: 		switch h.Val() {
69: 		case "ca":
70: 			if !h.NextArg() {
71: 				return nil, h.ArgErr()
72: 			}
73: 			caName := h.Val()
74: 			if h.NextArg() {
75: 				h.Prev()
76: 				return nil, h.ArgErr()
77: 			}
78: 			acmeServer.CA = caName
79: 			if ca == nil {
80: 				ca = new(caddypki.CA)
81: 			}
82: 			ca.ID = caName
83: 		case "lifetime":
84: 			if !h.NextArg() {
85: 				return nil, h.ArgErr()
86: 			}
87: 
88: 			lifetimeRaw := h.Val()
89: 			parsedLifetime, err := caddy.ParseDuration(lifetimeRaw)
90: 			if err != nil {
91: 				return nil, err
92: 			}
93: 			intermediateLifetime := time.Duration(ca.IntermediateLifetime)
94: 			requestedLifetime := parsedLifetime
95: 			if intermediateLifetime > 0 && requestedLifetime > intermediateLifetime {
96: 				return nil, h.Errf("certificate lifetime (%s) exceeds intermediate certificate lifetime (%s)", requestedLifetime, intermediateLifetime)
97: 			}
98: 			acmeServer.Lifetime = caddy.Duration(requestedLifetime)
99: 		case "resolvers":
100: 			var resolverArgs []string
101: 			for h.NextArg() {
102: 				resolverAddr := h.Val()
103: 				resolverArgs = append(resolverArgs, resolverAddr)
104: 			}
105: 			acmeServer.Resolvers = resolverArgs
106: 			if len(acmeServer.Resolvers) == 0 {
107: 				return nil, h.Errf("must specify at least one resolver address")
108: 			}
109: 		case "challenges":
110: 			challengeArgs := h.RemainingArgs()
111: 			parsedChallenges := make(ACMEChallenges, len(challengeArgs))
112: 			for i := 0; i < len(challengeArgs); i++ {
113: 				challengeName := challengeArgs[i]
114: 				parsedChallenges[i] = ACMEChallenge(challengeName)
115: 			}
116: 			existingChallenges := acmeServer.Challenges
117: 			acmeServer.Challenges = append(existingChallenges, parsedChallenges...)
118: 		case "allow_wildcard_names":
119: 			wildcardPolicy := acmeServer.Policy
120: 			if wildcardPolicy == nil {
121: 				wildcardPolicy = new(Policy)
122: 			}
123: 			wildcardPolicy.AllowWildcardNames = true
124: 			acmeServer.Policy = wildcardPolicy
125: 		case "allow":
126: 			r := &RuleSet{}
127: 			for h.Next() {
128: 				for h.NextBlock(h.Nesting() - 1) {
129: 					if h.CountRemainingArgs() != 0 {
130: 						switch h.Val() {
131: 						case "domains":
132: 							allowedDomains := h.RemainingArgs()
133: 							currentDomains := r.Domains
134: 							r.Domains = append(currentDomains, allowedDomains...)
135: 						case "ip_ranges":
